'''YSTF Glaiver Blightshade''' is an [[Elite enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|A manifestation of residual Æther energy that projects the outward form of a YSTF Glaiver. Such Yinglungs are extremely skilled in leading assaults and taking defended positions. The glaives they wield are designed to cleave through Aggeloi with ease.}}
